scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Welcome
to Einbroch,
the City of Steel.
Please ask me if you
have any questions.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
欢迎来到钢铁之城——艾音布罗克。
有什么问题，尽管问我。

scripts.text: City Guide.
scripts.translation: 城市导览

scripts.text: Remove Marks from Mini-Map.
scripts.translation: 移除小地图标记

scripts.text: Notice.
scripts.translation: 告示

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
Would you like me
to mark locations
on your Mini-Map?
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
需要我在您的小地图上标记位置吗？

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Einbroch Guide]
The ^FF0000Airport^000000 is located
in the northwestern part
of the city. There you can
see our city's pride and joy, the Airship. Remember that you must pay admission to board the Airship.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[艾音布罗克向导]
^FF0000机场^000000位于城西北。
在那里，您能看到这座城引以为傲的飞空艇。
请记住，登上飞空艇需要支付入场费。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Einbroch Guide]
The Train Station is
located in the northeast
part of Einbroch. Trains
running between here
and Einbech run all day
long, everyday.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[艾音布罗克向导]
火车站位于艾音布罗克东北部。
往返这里与艾音贝赫的火车，每天全天运行。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Einbroch Guide]
The Factory, perhaps the
most important facility in
Einbroch, is located in the
southern part of the city.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[艾音布罗克向导]
工厂位于城南，或许是艾音布罗克最重要的设施。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Einbroch Guide]
The Plaza, our biggest
shopping district, can be
found just east from the
center of Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[艾音布罗克向导]
广场是本城最大的购物区，就在艾音布罗克中心的东侧。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Einbroch Guide]
The Hotel is east of
the Plaza and offers top
caliber accomodations.
There, you can enjoy your
stay in Einbroch in comfort~
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[艾音布罗克向导]
酒店位于广场东边，提供一流的住宿服务。
您可以在那里舒舒服服地度过艾音布罗克之旅~

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Einbroch Guide]
The Weapon Shop is
located north from the
Plaza. There you can
purchase weapons for
your personal use.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[艾音布罗克向导]
武器店位于广场北边，您可以在那里购买自己使用的武器。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Einbroch Guide]
The Laboratory is an
annex of the Factory and
is located in the southwest
sector of Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[艾音布罗克向导]
实验室是工厂的附属设施，位于艾音布罗克西南部。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Einbroch Guide]
The Blacksmith Guild is
located in the southeast
part of Einbroch. You can
upgrade your equipment
by using their services.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[艾音布罗克向导]
铁匠公会位于艾音布罗克东南部。
您可以利用他们的服务提升装备。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Einbroch Guide]
The Einbroch Tower is
located in the center of
the city. From the top of
the tower, you can view
all of Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[艾音布罗克向导]
艾音布罗克塔位于城中心。
登上塔顶，就能俯瞰整座城市。

scripts.text:

the following menu.
[Einbroch Guide]

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Please ask me to ''Remove
Marks from Mini-Map'' if you
no longer wish to have the
location marks displayed
on your Mini-Map.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
如果不想让小地图继续显示地点标记，请选择“移除小地图标记”。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Okay, the marks from
your Mini-Map have been
removed. If you need any
guidance around Einbroch,
please let me or one of the
other Einbroch Guides know.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
好的，小地图上的标记已经移除了。
在艾音布罗克需要指路的话，随时可以找我或其他向导。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Through the technology of
the Schwarzwald Republic,
we've upgraded to a digital
information system that allows
us to mark locations on your
Mini-Map for easier navigation.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
借助修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的技术，我们升级了数字信息系统。
现在可以在您的小地图上标记地点，让您更容易找到路。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Your Mini-Map is located
in the upper right corner
of the screen. If you can't
see it, press the Ctrl + Tab
keys or click the ''Map'' button in your Basic Info Window.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
小地图位于屏幕右上角。
如果看不到，请按Ctrl + Tab，或点击基本信息窗口中的“地图”按钮。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
On your Mini-Map,
click on the ''+'' and ''-''
symbols to zoom in and
our of your Mini-Map. We
hope you enjoy your travels
here in Einbroch, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
点击小地图上的“+”和“-”，就能放大或缩小地图。
冒险者，祝您在艾音布罗克旅行愉快。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
We hope that you
enjoy your travels
here in Einbroch.
Oh, and please be
aware of the Smog Alerts.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
祝您在艾音布罗克旅行愉快。
哦，还有，别忘了留意烟雾警报。

scripts.text:
[Einbech Guide]
Welcome to Einbech,
the Mining Town. We're
here to assist tourists,
so if you have any questions,
please feel free to ask us.
scripts.translation:
[艾音贝赫向导]
欢迎来到矿业小镇——艾音贝赫。
我们专门为游客提供帮助，有什么问题，尽管问。

scripts.text:

Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Einbech Guide]

scripts.translation:
[艾音贝赫向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[艾音贝赫向导]
酒馆位于艾音贝赫南部。
忙碌一天后，去那里放松一下再好不过。

scripts.text:

Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Einbech Guide]
You can find the Tool

scripts.translation:

请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[艾音贝赫向导]

scripts.text:
[Einbech Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Einbech Guide]
The Swordman Guild
is located in the eastern
outskirts of Einbech. It's

haven't started accepting
applications.
scripts.translation:

请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[艾音贝赫向导]

目前还在建设中，尚未开始接受申请。

scripts.text:

Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Einbech Guide]

is located in the northern
part of this town. It's where
we get all our ores, although monsters get in the miners' way.
scripts.translation:

请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[艾音贝赫向导]

我们的矿石全都出自那里，可魔物总妨碍矿工的工作。
